transform_image_generation_request: transform a prompt into Gemini generateContent API request body with imageConfig and candidateCount
transform_image_generation_response: transform a Gemini generateContent response into litellm ImageResponse format with inline base64 image data
map_openai_params: map OpenAI image generation parameters like n, size, aspectRatio to Gemini format for Vertex AI
get_complete_url: build the Vertex AI generateContent API URL with project, location, and model name
validate_environment: validate Vertex AI environment by resolving credentials, project, and location and setting auth headers
